Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The New Zealand Women players stride out to the middle. Followed by Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia who walk out to open for India Women. Frances Mackay to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Now, the target is still a decent one to chase down. India do have a strong batting line up and if they bat well, they should chase this down. The New Zealand bowling has not been at its best but will have to deliver here if they are to come out on top. The wicket is a good one to bat on, there is some turn for the bowlers but it will be interesting to see how it plays under the lights. Stay tuned for the second half.

For the hosts, there were batters who got off to starts. The likes of Kerr and Amy scored half tons but none of them went onto make it big and that is what they needed.  They still were In a good position to end with something above 270 but wickets in heaps at the end has seen them fall short of that mark.

The key for India was, they kept taking wickets at regular intervals. Whenever it seemed like the Kiwis were taking the game away, they struck and managed to pull things back. Despite that though the hosts were always ahead in the game but the spell from Pooja at the end changed the course of the game. She was undoubtedly the pick with a four-fer. Rajeshwari and Jhulan supported her well and India have momentum heading into the break.

What a finish for India. Really don’t think there will be any doubt as to who will be the happier of the two sides heading into the break. New Zealand just lost their way completely. They were around 230 in the 43rd over with 5 wickets in hand but they have only managed around 40 runs in the last 7 overs or so. 36 to be precise in the last 46 balls and one believes they are probably slightly under par.

BYE! A length ball, on off. Hannah Rowe looks to whip it across the line but misses. The ball goes through towards the keeper. Frances Mackay wisely calls for a bye. New Zealand Women end their innings at 260/9.
Another single. A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Frances Mackay advances down the track and does enough to work it to the leg side for an easy single.
A yorker, in the blockhole. Hannah Rowe digs it out to cover for one.
Fuller, on leg. Frances Mackay flicks it through mid-wicket for another single.
Full length, on the pads. Hannah Rowe clips it to mid-wicket for one..
Hannah Rowe is the last batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Jhulan Goswami strikes in the final over of the innings and picks up her first wicket. Goswami serves it full and on the stumps. Katey Martin tries to heave it away but misses. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps.

DROPPED AND TWO! That is poor from Raj. Let alone the drop but the two conceded after that, really poor. Outside off, Mackay looks to go over covers. Ends up slicing it towards cover. Raj runs in but spills it. She does not run towards the ball after that. The batters spot that and go for two. Raj now goes after it but too late. A good over then for the Kiwis. They would love another good one to end.
FOUR! Finally gets one away. The long awaited boundary comes for the hosts. This is on the pads, Mackay seeeps, it goes through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller and outside off, Martin hits it towards mid off and takes another single.
Fuller and on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for only one. Boundaries just hard to come by.
Martin steps out. This is a dipping full toss, it is hit down to long on for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
WIDE! Extras will help! Down the leg side. Mackay looks to flick but misses.
Direct hit could have been close! On middle, Mackay works it towards mid-wicket and takes off. The fielder has a shy but misses. Another brilliant over for India.
Just the one! Singles won't harm India! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Third dot in the over. A yorker on middle, Martin jams it out and wants a run but is sent back.
Good field placement. Martin looks to okay the paddle scoop but this is bowled outside off. She ends up guiding it to a fielder which is at gully but a little deeper.
A single now and Mackay probably does the right thing by Martin on strike. On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
On off, Mackay guides it to short third man. Another dot.
A dot to end! Shorter and out off, this is played to point. End of a game changing over.
Mackay is off the mark! Shorter and on off, this is guided to point for one.
No hat-trick. Really well played! That is another yorker on middle, it is jammed back to the bowler.
Frances Mackay is the new batter in.

OUT! TWO IN TWO FOR POOJA! She has 4 and is on a hat-trick. This is death bowling at its best. Another yorker, the line is a little on the leg. Kerr looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and deflects onto the stumps. India now have a chance to keep the Kiwis to under 260.
Jess Kerr comes in at number 9.

OUT! TIMBER! Pooja continues to enjoy her time in this World Cup. She picks up her third wicket. That is a corker of a yorker. On middle, Lea fails to get her bat down in time and the stumps are hit. 270 now totally depends on Martin.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for one.

A dot to end! Yet again a boundary in the over but only 6 from it. On middle, this one holds its line. Tahuhu looks to flick, closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge but lands safe on the off side.
Slower and around off, extra bounce. Lea swings but misses.
Outside off, this is slapped towards cover. A misfield but only one.
FOUR! Shot! Gets it nice and fine. Martin shuffles across, this is bowled on middle, Martin hits it past backward square leg and into the fence.
Just wide! On middle, Tahuhu looks to flick, it goes off the leading edge but wide of the bowler and down to long on for one.
Lea Tahuhu is the new batter.

OUT! TIMBER! New Zealand are losing their way now. The runs have dried up and that pressure has gotten to Jensen who now loses her off pole. Lovely delivery. Gives it air, lands it full and on off. Jensen looks to heave it across the line but misses and the off pole is hit.
Outstanding, outstanding stuff from Pooja. A boundary on the first ball and then 5 dots. Magical. Fuller again, this is pushed to mid off.
What a comeback after going for a boundary on the first ball. 4 dots. Shorter and on middle, this is pulled to mid-wicket.
Make that three! This is a yorker on middle, Martin jams it back to the bowler after stepping out. Pooja has a shy at the keeper's end but does not hit the stumps.
Another dot! Full again and outside off, Martin drives but to covers.
Bowling! A yorker outside off, Martin looks to jam it out. It misses the bat.

FOUR! Clever batting! New Zealand would love a few more of these. The scoop comes out. Martin gets the line too, on middle, she hits it over short fine leg and it races away. Can they make this into a big over now?
Three dots in a row to end another good over for India. Slower through the air again and on middle, Jensen looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slower through the air and on middle, Jensen defends.
Smart bowling! This is pushed through, quicker and outside off. Jensen cuts but is beaten.
Martin now sweeps, it goes through square leg for one.
Nice shot for two. Martin steps out and lifts it wide of long off for two.
On middle, Martin looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off a soft leading edge back to the bowler.

Going down leg. That always seemed the case. A waste of a review. A yorker to end on the pads. Jensen fails to jam it out. She gets hit on the pads. An appeal but turned down. Review taken but it is not a good one. The over though is a brilliant one.
Dots are gold at the moment! Outside off, Jensen drives but to point.
Just the single again! Fuller and on off, this is driven to cover for one more.
On off, this is pushed to covers for one.
Hayley Jensen is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the fielder and Raj makes no mistake. Big wicket, it is the well set Amy who falls with over 7 overs to go. This could well make a difference of 20 runs to the final total. It is full and on middle, Amy whips it but straight to mid-wicket. Easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mithali Raj b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Two! On middle, fuller, this is hit wide of long on for two.
A single to end an over in which there should have been a wicket. Amy comes down the track and swings, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.

Dropped! That was a sitter. Pooja Vastrakar is the culprit. This is slower and outside off, Martin looks to sweep but it goes off the top edge. Pooja at short third man settles under it but spills it. India needed that wicket. This could prove costly now.
Now the paddle sweep comes out. It is played fine on the leg side for two.
Two! Plays the reverse sweep, it goes more off the top edge but fine on the off side. Two taken.
Amy comes down the track and hits it hard down to long on for one.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back into the attack now.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
A yorker on middle, Amy jams it out towards short fine leg for one.
Well played in the end! Martin looks to play the paddle scoop but this is bowled outside off. She jams it out to point for one.
Martin walks down. This is full and on off, it is driven to covers.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, it is pushed to long off for one.
A single now as this is hit down to long off.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the innings.
FOUR! Innovation now! Third boundary in the over and it is just the kind of over New Zealand needed. The reverse sweep, she manages to hit it fine on the off side and bags a boundary.
On off, this is hit hard to covers.
FOUR! Swept powerfully. Constructive boundaries and she has probably got going after that first boundary. On middle, this is swept hard through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and a boundary results.
Shorter and outside off, Amy slaps it hard but to covers.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for the Kiwis. Amy was desperate for one and she finds it. Steps out and this time gets to the pitch of it. She hits it hard wide of long on for a boundary. 200 up.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one more. Amy is really looking to hit the ball hard now.
Fuller and on middle, Amy jams it out on the leg side.
Full and on the pads, Martin looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.

Good cricket! This is full and outside off, Martin just opens the face of the bat and guides it through point. The fielder in the deep dives to her right after making a lot. If ground and keeps it down to two.
Fuller and outside off, Martin looks to cut but misses.
A single to end! Outside off, Martin plays it to point for one.
Two! Outside off, this is guided down to third man for a couple.
Martin plays the much preferred sweep but to square leg.

Lands short! Well bowled again. Sees Amy come down the track and slows it up. The length is also dragged back. Amy still looks to lift it downtown but gets it off the toe end. That saves her as it lands ahead of long off. Two.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Good bowling! Slower through the air and lands it outside off. Defended.
Fuller and on off, Amy looks to hit it hard but does so to mid off. A very good over by Pooja.
Another dot! On the stumps, Amy does not get it past mid-wicket.
On the pads, Amy flicks but finds the fielder.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Outside off, Martin guides it down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A dot to end! On the stumps, this is clipped to mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! On middle, Martin sweeps and finds the gap in the square leg region for a boundary. Welcome one for New Zealand.
On middle, this is flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
On middle, Amy works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Another one floated up on off, blocked.
On middle, defended.
On the pads, Martin looks to sweep, it goes off the top edge but over short fine leg for two.
On middle, kept out.
A run as this is pushed through covers.
On the pads, this is swept but to short fine leg.
Shorter and outside off, Martin cuts but to point.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
No trouble!! Amy is in! On off, this is pushed towards cover. They go for one. The fielder hits the stumps at the bowler's end. It is referred but replays show the batter is in.
Katey Martin comes in at number 6.

OUT! STRAIGHT TO THE FIELDER! Sharma gets the wicket and it is a timely one. The two would have probably looked to up the ante. Green though was looking to do that. She steps out and gets a little too close to the pitch of the ball. She lifts but straight to Smriti Mandhana who takes a good catch at long on. So whenever the hosts have seemed like taking the game away, India always manage to get a wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Smriti Mandhana b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Two and fifty for Amy Satterthwaite. A really good innings so far but she would know the job is only half done. She gets there by lifting it wide of long off for two.
Floats it up on off, Green eases it down to long off and takes one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Another run! Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
A single as this is hit down to long off.
On off, kept out.
On off, this is eased down to long off for one.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Tickled fine! On the pads, this is worked towards fine leg for two.
Outside off, this is dragged through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, kept out.
Uppishly but wide! Amy comes down the track and looks to lift it over covers. She does not get the elevation she would have wanted but it is in the gap and two is taken.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
Shot! Fuller and on middle, this is whipped hard wide of long on for two.
On off, blocked.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Lofted for two! Not timed that well but well enough. Fuller and on middle, Green looks to go downtown with mid on and mid off up. She gets it more off the toe end but clears the two and two is taken.
Fuller and on off, Green finds mid off.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Good bowling! Sees Amy come down, slows it up and drags the length back. Amy pushes it past the bowler and down to long off for one.
Slows it up and lands it on off, blocked.
On middle again, this is flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, this is eased down to long on for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On the stumps, defended.
Crsip! Fuller and on off, this is stroked nicely but to mid off. Seems a belter of a wicket.
Angled into the pads, Amy flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Another one fuller and on off, Amy finds the cover fielder again.
Fuller again and outside off, Amy can't find the gap in the cover region.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid on.
Good stop in the end! Fuller and on off, this is driven firmly back towards the bowler. Goswami gets down and gets a hand to it. It goes towards mid off but a single is taken.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On middle, kept out.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Shorter and on the pads, this is pulled on the leg side for one.
Now follows the boundary with a single as this is eased down to long on.
FOUR! Only dealing in boundaries at the moment are the hosts! Fuller and outside off, Amy drives, she finds the gap through covers and bags a boundary.
Make that 4! Outside off, this is pushed to cover.
Once again three dots to begin the over! Outside off, this is guided to point.
Another one on the stumps, Amy nudges it to mid-wicket.
From around the wicket, this is angled into middle, Amy works it to mid-wicket.
A dot to end but 8 from the over! Length and on off, defended.

FOUR! Good effort in the field but in vain. Consecutive boundaries and all the good work at the start of the over has been undone. Just a little bit of width on offer this time, outside off. Green cuts it through point. Rana runs to her right from third man and dives, she almost stops it but right at the end, the ball rolls out of her and into the fence.
FOUR! Way too short and put away! That will release the pressure that was building. On middle, Green rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Three dots in a row! This is good stuff from India. On middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Good length and on middle, this is worked to mid on.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Green guides it to point.
Looped up, on off. Amy Satterthwaite defends it back to the bowler. 6 runs come off the over.
Full and on off. Green drives it down the ground for one.
Full and on off. Green drives it to cover.
FOUR! Maddy Green gets her first boudary of the innings. Floated, full and angled down leg. Sneh Rana gets low and drives it through square leg for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Maddy Green goes back and works it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted, full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it through covers for a single.
Fuller, on the stumps. Maddy Green does really well to block it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Green pushes it to cover with soft hands.
Fuller, on leg. Green blocks it to the leg side.
Full and on the pads. Maddy Green flicks it to short mid-wicket.
On off, blocked into the deck.
On middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite guides it to third man for one.
Short and on off. Green cuts it to point for a single.
On off, blocked out.

CLOSE! Looped up, angling down leg. Green hangs back and tries to flick it away but misses. She gets the ball off her gloves, as it goes to the left of the keeper. Richa Ghosh attempts to grab the ball but fais to reach in time.
Full and on leg. Amy Satterthwaite clips it to leg side for one.
FOUR! Amy Satterthwaite oozing with confidence. Full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it through covers for a boundary.

Review! Amelia Kerr takes the review for lbw. The on-field decision is OUT. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows it is umpire's call on impact and the ball goes on to hit the stumps. The on-field decision stands but New Zealand Women do not lose a review.

OUT! LBW! Rajeshwari Gayakwad picks up a crucial wicket and send back a set-batter in Amelia Kerr. It is looped up, around off. Amelia Kerr gets on one knee and goes for the sweep shot but misses it completely. Rajeshwari Gayakwad appeals and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. Amelia Kerr has a chat with her partner and takes it upstairs. Although it does not work in her favour and she has to head back to the dugout. Maddy Green is the new batter in.
Full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it to mid-wicket for one.
On off, defended out solidly.
Amelia Kerr continues to go from strength to strength at the number 3 spot. FIFTY FOR KERR! Full and on off. Kerr pushes it to mid on for an easy single.
Around off, Kerr punches it to cover but not in the gap.
On middle and leg. Kerr blocks it back to the bowler.
Full, on off. Kerr pushes it to cover for a single.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
On off, Amelia Kerr pushes it to cover.
Looped up, outside off. Kerr tries to play it late but misses.
Lifeline! Amy Satterthwaite thanking her stars at the moment. Full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite lofts it high in the air towards mid on. It lands safely between two fielders and they take one.
Tossed up, on off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it to cover, not in the gap.
On off, blocked out.

FOUR LEG BYES! Looped up, full and on off. Amelia Kerr tries to go for the reverse sweep. Although the ball brushes her pads and races down to third man fence for a boundary. Amelia Kerr still needs to wait for her celebration.
Amelia Kerr suggests that there were five fielders outside the circle. Hence, the umpire has given a free-hit.
NO BALL! The umpire signals a no ball, as there was an extra fielder outside the circle. On off, blocked out.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Amy Satterthwaite flicks it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Action replay of the previous delivery. Full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite dances down the track and lifts it over mid offf or a boundary.
FOUR! Good use of the feet. The stand moves to 53 with this boundary. Full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite comes down the track and lofts it over mid off and it races away to the fence.
Full, outside off. Amelia Kerr drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Around off, Kerr plays it into the off side for another single. 9 runs off it. A good over for New Zealand Women.
Fuller, on off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it to cover for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Tossed up, full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite slogs it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary. 100 up for New Zealand Women.
Floated, full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite hits it flat and hard on the up towards mid on.
On the pads, Kerr clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller, outside off. Amelia Kerr waits for it and guides it through backward point for a brace.
Change of ends for Sneh Rana. She replaces Pooja Vastrakar now.
Overpitched, outside off. Amelia Kerr drives it through covers for one. A tidy over by Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes to an end.
Full length, outside off. Amelia Kerr blocks it to cover.
Angled into the pads. Kerr goes inside the crease and defends it out safely.
Full, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, full, on off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to cover.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Kerr drives it to cover for one.
Full length, on off. Amy Satterthwaite defends it back to the bowler. A bit of aggression shown by Pooja Vastrakar, as she fires the ball towards the batter.
Fuller, outside off. Kerr bunts it to backward point for one.
FOUR! Incredible shot! Full length, outside off. Amelia Kerr leans in the shot and creams it through the cover region for a boundary.
Length, on off. Amy Satterthwaite punches it to point for a single.
Full and on the stumps. Amy Satterthwaite defends it watchfully.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Some extra bounce off the deck. Amy Satterthwaite tries to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it to the right of mid off. Smriti Mandhana there moves to that side and makes half-stop with a dive. The batters take one.
Floated, full and outside off. Amelia Kerr guides it through backward point for three runs.
Three dots in a row! Full and on off. Kerr defends it into the deck.
Short and on off. Kerr cuts it to cover. Not in the gap though.
Full and on off. Kerr defends it out on the front foot.
FOUR! Amelia Kerr welcomes Sneh Rana into the attack warmly. Looped up, full and down leg. Amelia Kerr gets low and sweeps it to fine leg for one.

DRINKS! Incredible fight shown by both the teams until now. India Women do have the upper had with two wickets up their sleeve. The bowlers did really well to put early pressure on the hosts. New Zealand Women need the current pair of Amelia Kerr and Amy Satterthwaite to build a solid stand and take them to safer shores. India Women would be aiming to pick a couple more wickets. An interesting passage of play awaits.
Tidy finish to a tidy over. Full and on the stumps yet again. Amy Satterthwaite blocks it out.
Four dots on the trot! Full length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it to mid off.
Length ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite hits it to cover.
Another full-length delivery, on the stumps. Amy Satterthwaite blocks it out with ease.
Full length, on off. Amy Satterthwaite defends it to cover.
Length ball, outside off. Kerr guides it to third man for a single.
On the pads. Kerr tucks it to square leg for an easy single. Deepti Sharma is unable to keep the run flow in check.
FOUR! Nicely played. Tossed up, full, on off. Amelia Kerr gets low and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Outside off, tapped to point.
Looped up, full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it in the air towards deep mid-wicket and they take a single. Amy Satterthwaite racks up 4500 runs for New Zealand Women in ODIs.
Angled in, full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite stays inside the crease and defends it to the off side.
Floated, on off. Kerr works it to long on for one.
Full length, just outside off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to mid off.
Full length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite defends it to mid off.
Fuller, on off. Amy Satterthwaite works it towards mid on.

FOUR! Amy Satterthwaite gets off the mark with a boundary. Back of a length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite uses her height really well and gets on top of the ball to dispatch it towards the point boundary.
Yorker length delivery, outside off. Kerr digs it out to backward point for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Kerr works it to cover.
Length and on the stumps. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to cover safely. 9 runs off the over, an expensive start for Deepti Sharma.
Fuller, on leg. Amelia Kerr flicks it to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Amelia Kerr is on a roll here. A short ball, outside off. Kerr makes the most of the width on offer. Kerr cuts it through point and collects a boundary.
FOUR! Amelia Kerr looking to up her ante now. Tossed up, full and on off. Kerr comes down the track and lofts it over mid on to find a boundary.
On off, blocked out.
Fuller, on leg. Amelia Kerr defends it to mid on.
Amy Satterthwaite is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pooja Vastrakar picks up her first wicket in the World Cup and it is a priced wicket of the White Ferns skipper. India Women well on top at the moment. Back of a length, around off. Sophie Devine is left with little room, as she tries to cut it away on the back foot. The ball though flies off the outside edge and goes to the right of the keeper. Richa Ghosh moves to that side and pouches the ball safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, outside off. Sophie Devine gets low and works it to cover off the inner half, as she tries to slash it away.
Length ball, outside off. Kerr plays it late and works it to third man for one.
Fuller, on off. Devine drives it through covers for another single.
Touch short, around off. Amelia Kerr guides it down to third man for a single.
Full length, outside off. Amelia Kerr drives it to cover-point.
End of Powerplay 1! That means now 4 fielders will be allowed to be placed outside the 30-yard circle.
Fuller, on off. Kerr sweeps it to mid-wicket for one.

Tough chance! Floated, full and on off. Amelia Kerr gets low and goes for the sweep shot. The ball takes the top-edge and flies towards deep square leg. The ball is in the air. Yastika Bhatia charges towards the ball in the deep, she puts in a forward dive but is unable to gather the ball before it comes in contact with the ground. They take two.
Fuller, on leg. Amelia Kerr tucks it to the leg side.
Flatter and outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it to point not in the gap.
Tossed up, full and on the stumps. Kerr blocks it out watchfully.
Looped up, full and angling down leg. Sophie Devine gets low and sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack now.
Good length, on off. Kerr defends it back to the bowler. Two dots in a row to end the over. 5 runs come off it.
A length ball, on off. Kerr blocks it out solidly.
Full, on leg. Sophie Devine flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Full length, on the fourth stump line. Sophie Devine leans in and drives it through cover. Pooja Vastrakar gets low and lets the ball go through her palms. Boundary.
Fuller and on the stumps. Sophie Devine blocks it back to the bowler.
Short ball, on off. Sophie Devine pushes it to the off side.
Length ball, on off. Kerr punches it to point off the back foot.
Length ball, outside off, shaping away a touch. Sophie Devine taps it to point for a quick single.
On the pads, tucked to fine leg.
Overpitched, on off. Sophie Devine drives it to mid off.
WIDE! Fuller and down leg. Sophie Devine tries to chase it but misses. Wide called. Richa Ghosh does well to stop the ball.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full length, outside off. Sophie Devine leans in and crunches it through covers to bag a boundary.
Full length, around off. Kerr shuffles across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Kerr steers it down to third man now for another single.
Back of a length, around off. Sophie Devine plays it late and guides it down to third man for one.
Four dots on the trot! Fuller, on leg. Devine defends it to the leg side.
Back of a length, outside off. Devine helps it to the off side.
Good length, on the fourth stump line. Sophie Devine taps it to point.
Length ball, on the stumps. Sophie Devine stays inside the crease and blocks it out solidly.
Just 2 runs off the over! Meghna Singh really managed to keep things tight in this over. Fuller, on off. Amelia Kerr drives it to cover.
Full length, outside off. Kerr defends it to cover.
An outswinger, full and on off. Kerr pushes it to cover but not in the gap.
Full length, outside off. It flies off the deck. Amelia Kerr leaves it alone for the keeper.
Fuller, on the pads. Kerr nurdles it through mid-wicket for one.
An inswinger, full and on off. Kerr defends it out solidly.

FOUR! Sophie Devine moves to 22. She is only dealing in boundaries at the moment. A short ball, outside off. Sophie Devine rides the bounce and cuts it through point for a cracking boundary. A good stand developing for the second-wicket.
FOUR! Sophie Devine at her best! Full-length ball, outside off. Sophie Devine stride forward and carves it through the covers for a boundary.
Touch short and on the stumps. Sophie Devine stays inside the crease and defends it out watchfully.
Fuller, on the stumps. Sophie Devine defends it into the deck on the front foot.
A length ball, outside off. Amelia Kerr guides it down to third man for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Sophie Devine drives it to cover for one.
Full length, on the pads. Amelia Kerr flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Full, outside off. Sophie Devine stays back and pushes it to cover for one.
Length and on off. Devine pushes it to cover.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Sophie Devine looks to be in fine touch now! A short ball, outside off, moving away a bit. Sophie Devine stands tall and cuts it through point for a boundary. Mithali Raj seeing Sophie Devine leave her crease puts Richa Ghosh close to the stumps. This should restrict Sophie Devine's movement in the crease.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A low full toss, on off. Sophie Devine stays back and drives it down the ground for a glorious boundary.

WIDE! Full length, angled down leg. Sophie Devine tries to flick it away but misses. She bangs her blade on the deck and maybe that created some sound. The keeper collects the ball low to her left and appeals but the umpire says no and later signals a wide to add salt to the wound.
A full-length delivery, on middle, swinging away a bit late. Sophie Devine looks to drive and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Five dots on the trot to end the over! Overpitched, on off. Kerr drives it to cover but is unable to get it through the gap.
Full length, on off. Kerr defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, on off. Kerr pushes it out to safety.
Good length, outside off. Amelia Kerr tries to chase it but misses.
Length and on off, blocked out solidly.
Amelia Kerr comes in to bat now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pooja Vastrakar comes out with her golden arm and hands India an early breakthrough. Suzie Bates goes back to the pavilion without troubling the score much. A length ball, on off. Sophie Devine pushes it to covers with soft hands. Earlier, it looked as if it was an easy single, but it loks like Suzie Bates was somehow a little late to take off and Pooja Vastrakar's direct hit made a difference in the end.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays show Suzie Bates is short of the crease and the big screen shows OUT.
Full length, on off. Bates defends it to the off side. Just 4 runs off it.
Length and outside off. Suzie Bates bends her knees and cuts it to point. Not in the gap though.

FOUR! Streaky! Suzie Bates knows shes lucky and has a smile across her place. A full-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Suzie Bates expands her arms and goes for the booming drive. She does not middle it. In fact, it takes the outside edge and flies over the slip cordon. Boundary.
Overpitched, on off. Suzie Bates makes a little room and drives it to mid off on the up.
Fuller, outside off, swinging away. Bates tries to drive it down the ground but is unable to clear the mid off fielder.
Fuller, outside off. Suzie Bates blocks it to cover.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Meghna Singh.
Length, on off, blocked out.
FOUR! Sophie Devine is off the mark is fine fashion. A good-length ball, outside off. Sophie Devine gets on top of the ball and carves it through point for a boundary.

EDGY! SAFE! A back-of-a-length ball, around off. Suzie Bates looks to punch it through the off side. The ball takes the outside edge and flies between slips and gully. Only for a singlle down to third man.
Good length, outside off. Suzie Bates plays it late and guides it towards gully.

A really good effort by Harmanpreet Kaur! Full length, on middle and leg. Suzie Bates lifts her back leg and flicks it aerially towards short mid-wicket. Harmanpreet Kaur there dives to her right and grabs the ball on a bounce with a single hand.
A full-length ball, on off. Bates defends it out watchfully.

Done with the pre-match proceedings! The Indian players now spread out and take the field. They are followed by Sophie Devine and Suzie Bates who walk out to open for New Zealand Women. Jhulan Goswami to start with the new ball. But before she bowls the first ball, all the New Zealand Women take the knee to show their support for the 'Black Lives Matter' movement, while the Indian players pay respect by standing tall with a hand on their hearts. Here we go...
We are set for the clash. First, both the teams walk out on the field and get lined-up for their respective national anthems. It will India's first followed by the one for the home side.

PITCH REPORT - Lisa Sthalekar is near the deck. She says, the dimensions will play a role here. Craig McMillan joins and suggests that this deck is a completely different soil and will offer some turn. Adds past score for the team batting first would be around 240 or 250.

Sophie Devine, New Zealand Women skipper, is in for a chat. She says, they would’ve loved to bat first anyways. Adds they need to post 250/260 to post a competitive total. Says they will try to replicate their effort against India just like the series at home. Ends by saying, they do not have any changes.

Mithali Raj, the Indian skipper, says they will bat first. Adds this is a good wicket to bat on and they hope the dew to play a part as the game progresses. Mentions they have a single change to their side.

New Zealand Women (Unchanged playing XI) - Sophie Devine (C), Suzie Bates, Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Maddy Green, Frances Mackay, Katey Martin (WK), Hayley Jensen, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr and Hannah Rowe.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia (In for Shafali Verma), Deepti Sharma, Harmanpreet Kaur, Mithali Raj (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Jhulan Goswami, Meghna Singh, Pooja Vastrakar, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of India Women. They have opted to BOWL first.

The Kiwis began the tournament in the worst possible way but hammered Bangladesh to bag their first points. They will be confident against this Indian side and will back themselves to make it two in two wins. Can they do so? We will find out. Toss and teams in a bit.

India, after beating the Kiwis in the last ODI before the biggest tournament have carried forward the momentum. They thumped Pakistan in the first game and will be high in confidence. The Indians usually find ways to do well in such big occasions and it won’t come as a surprise if they beat the Kiwis yet again.

Game 8 of the World Cup sees a clash between hosts, New Zealand and India. The two sides will probably know each other quite a lot as they faced each other in 5 ODI games just before the World Cup. It was the Kiwis who won 4 but the Indians managed to win the last match of the series. Two sides with abundance of quality. This should be a cracker.
... MATCH DAY ...
